run_gradio_demo: run the Gradio demo interface for AV-HuBERT audio-visual speech recognition with webcam or upload
extract_lip_movement: extract lip movement frames from a video by detecting face landmarks and cropping the mouth region
detect_landmark: detect 68 facial landmarks on a single image frame using dlib detector and predictor models
process_input_video: process an input video by extracting lip movement, mixing audio with noise, and running AV-HuBERT inference
launch_tabbed_interface: launch a tabbed Gradio interface with record video and upload video tabs for AV-HuBERT demo
